subject: Sculpture (Fine Arts)

source.title: Fine Arts (Painting, Graphics, Sculpture, Applied Art), Codes 049-052, Classes XI-XII (2026-27)

notes: Theory (History of Indian Art, 30 marks, 2 hours) is common to Painting, Graphics, Sculpture and Applied Art. The practical paper (70 marks, 6 hours) is specific to each.
Questions are set only from the artworks listed.

units.name: Pre-Historic Rock Paintings, Indus Civilisation; Buddhist, Jain and Hindu Art

chapters.name: Pre-Historic Rock Paintings and Art of the Indus Valley Civilisation
topics: Period and location; Wizard's Dance, Bhimbetka
Indus sites: Harappa, Mohenjo-daro, Ropar, Lothal, Rangpur, Alamgirpur, Kalibangan, Banawali, Dholavira
Bronze casting; Dancing Girl, Male Torso, Mother Goddess
Bull seal; painted earthenware jar

chapters.name: Buddhist, Jain and Hindu Art (3rd century BCE to 8th century CE)
topics: Mauryan polish, Shunga, Kushana (Gandhara, Mathura) and Gupta styles
Lion Capital from Sarnath; Chauri Bearer from Didarganj; Seated Buddha from Katra Mound; Jain Tirthankara (Gupta)
Ajanta: location, period, chaitya and vihara caves, Bodhisattva Padmapani; rock-cut architecture, sculpture, fresco

units.name: Temple Sculptures, Bronzes and Indo-Islamic Architecture

chapters.name: Indian Temple Sculpture (6th to 13th century CE)
topics: Descent of Ganga, Mahabalipuram (Pallava)
Trimurti, Elephanta
Lakshmi Narayana, Kandariya Mahadev Temple, Khajuraho (Chandela)
Cymbal Player, Konark Sun Temple (Ganga)
Mother and Child, Vimal Shah Temple, Dilwara (Solanki)

chapters.name: Indian Bronzes
topics: Introduction; solid and hollow casting
Nataraja (Chola), Thanjavur

chapters.name: Artistic Aspects of Indo-Islamic Architecture
topics: Qutub Minar, Delhi
Gol Gumbaz, Bijapur

chapters.name: Modelling in Relief
topics: Relief in clay or plaster of Paris on subjects from life and nature
Simplified human figures, birds, animals and plants; geometric shapes

chapters.name: Modelling in Round
topics: Round modelling from life and nature
Clay techniques: pinching, coiling, rolling; hollow clay for baking

chapters.name: Sculpture Portfolio
topics: Year's record (8); four selected works (6); three folk art pieces (6)
